title: Exploring the Horror of Supernatural Fiction: Ray Bradbury’s Elliot Family edited by Miranda Corcoran & Steve Ellerhoff
author: Thomas E. Simmons
summary: In Exploring the Horror of Supernatural Fiction: Ray Bradbury’s Elliott Family (2020), Miranda Corcoran and Steve Gronert Ellerhoff collect a dozen essays exploring science fiction master Ray Bradbury’s From the Dust Returned (2001).
